03 / AVID GOLF

Built for indoor play.

Foresight’s overhead, four-camera tracking keeps the unit off the floor and measures the ball and club around impact.

Clubhead measurement requires the appropriate hitting zone and club markers. Our team can help with setup. View sticker pricing.

Technical specifications: Foresight Sports Falcon.

Why we chose Foresight.

Practice with a clearer picture.

For AVID, useful feedback matters. Foresight combines ball and club measurements to support practice, coaching and fittings. The Falcon upgrade will make clubhead insight available throughout the facility, rather than limiting it to selected bays.
